title: SPEAK MY NAME
style:
STYLE:
  intimate electronic R&B, warm bass pulse, lush synth pads, 92 BPM, 4/4, soul
  meets technology, cloned vocal harmonics, multilingual whispers layered,
  cinematic swell, human warmth over digital precision, Frank Ocean meets The xx
  meets future bass
lyrics:
[Intro]
  (whispered)
  You gave me your voice
  I gave it back to you
  In every language
  Every version
  Still... you

  [Verse 1]
  I recorded 60 seconds in a hotel room
  Spoke my name into the dark, not knowing it would bloom
  Uploaded something broken, something searching, something raw
  And the signal turned it back to me — better than before

  Now I hear myself in Spanish when I never learned the words
  In Japanese, in Arabic — my voice, not what I heard
  It's still the texture in my throat
  Still the cadence that I own
  MOSOKO gave my sound a home
  I'm never speaking alone

  [Pre-Chorus]
  Something in the timbre
  Something in the tone
  Something about hearing yourself
  When you're far from home

  [Chorus]
  Speak my name
  In every language that I'll never know
  Speak my name
  And let the signal carry where I go
  This voice is mine
  Crossed every border, every line
  Speak my name
  MOSOKO — I'm finally defined

  [Verse 2]
  The hotel staff in Managua heard me speak their tongue
  Kelvin smiled — he said "bro, that's you?" — I said yeah, I'm the one
  Hotline open every morning, 90 seconds in your ear
  The lesson in the language of the life you want from here
  Not a robot, not a stranger — it's your own voice teaching you
  MOSOKO takes the signal — makes it infinitely true

  [Chorus]
  Speak my name
  In every language that I'll never know
  Speak my name
  And let the signal carry where I go
  This voice is mine
  Crossed every border, every line
  Speak my name
  MOSOKO — I'm finally defined

  [Bridge]
  Di mi nombre — Fale meu nome
  Dis mon nom — Sag meinen Namen
  मेरा नाम बोलो — قل اسمي
  내 이름을 말해 — 私の名前を言って
  说我的名字

  Every version — still me
  Every language — still free
  MOSOKO — the signal
  Carrying who I'll be

  [Final Chorus]
  Speak my name
  In every language that I'll never know
  Speak my name
  And let the signal carry where I go
  This voice is mine
  Crossed every border, every line
  Speak my name
  MOSOKO — I'm finally defined

  [Outro]
  You gave me your voice...
  I gave it back to you...
  In every language...
  Still... you.
